map.内生肌酐清除率 Ccr(mL/min) = [尿肌酐(μmol/L) × 尿量(: Endogenous creatinine clearance Ccr (mL/min) = [urine creatinine (μmol/L) × urine flow (mL/min)] ÷ serum creatinine (μmol/L); Ccr is also corrected for body surface area as Ccr × 1.73 ÷ BSA.
map.Ccr 50-80 为轻度损害，25-50 为中度损害，10-25 为重度损害，: Ccr 50-80 indicates mild impairment, 25-50 moderate, 10-25 severe, and <10 end-stage renal disease.
map.提示：收集24h尿液前3天需低蛋白饮食（<40g/d），禁食肉食，避免剧烈运动，: Note: for the 3 days before 24h urine collection a low-protein diet (<40 g/d) is required, with no meat and no strenuous exercise, to keep creatinine excretion stable. Ccr reflects glomerular filtration, but the tubules also secrete a small amount of creatinine, so Ccr is slightly higher than true GFR. This tool is for learning reference only.
map.尿 Cr 8.8mmol/L、尿量 1500mL、Scr 80：尿率 1.042: Urine Cr 8.8 mmol/L, urine volume 1500 mL, Scr 80: urine flow 1.042 mL/min, Ccr=8800×1.042/80≈114.6 mL/min; with BSA 1.73 no correction is needed.
map.BSA<1.73 时 Ccr×(1.73/BSA) 校正，消除体型偏倚。: When BSA<1.73, correct as Ccr×(1.73/BSA) to remove body size bias.
map.Ccr 受年龄/肌肉影响偏高，eGFR 更稳；二者结合判读。: Ccr is biased upward by age and muscle mass, while eGFR is more stable; interpret the two together.
map.留尿不全会低估，建议复查或改用血公式。: Incomplete collection leads to underestimation; repeat the test or switch to a serum-based formula.

map.24小时肌酐清除率(Ccr)计算器，根据24h尿肌酐、尿量、血肌酐计算内生肌酐清: 24-hour creatinine clearance (Ccr) calculator: computes endogenous creatinine clearance from 24h urine creatinine, urine volume and serum creatinine, with support for body surface area correction. A professional medical tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
map.内生肌酐清除率 Ccr(mL/min) = [尿肌酐(μmol/L) × 尿量(: Endogenous creatinine clearance Ccr (mL/min) = [urine creatinine (μmol/L) × urine flow (mL/min)] ÷ serum creatinine (μmol/L); corrected by body surface area as Ccr × 1.73 ÷ BSA. Ccr strata (≥80 / 50–79 / 25–49 / 10–24 / <10) are functional descriptions on this page, not equivalent to KDIGO 2012 eGFR-based CKD stages G1–G5; Ccr slightly overestimates true GFR (tubular creatinine secretion). Results are hints requiring clinical review.
map.肌酐清除率在常见参考范围内；仍需结合尿检、eGFR 与临床评估。: Creatinine clearance is within the common reference range; still combine urinalysis, eGFR and clinical assessment.
map.肌酐清除率轻度下降，注意经肾排泄药物的剂量调整与随访。: Creatinine clearance is mildly reduced; adjust renally excreted drugs and follow up.
map.肌酐清除率中度下降，建议肾内科评估，监测并发症与药物剂量。: Creatinine clearance is moderately reduced; nephrology assessment, monitor complications and drug doses.
map.肌酐清除率重度下降，提示晚期肾功能不全；是否需肾脏替代治疗由肾内科综合评估，本页: Creatinine clearance is severely reduced, suggesting advanced renal insufficiency; whether renal replacement therapy is needed is decided by nephrology; this page does not make that decision.
map.肌酐清除率极重度下降；肾脏替代治疗时机须由肾内科结合症状、eGFR、电解质与容量: Creatinine clearance is very severely reduced; timing of renal replacement therapy must be assessed by nephrology using symptoms, eGFR, electrolytes and volume status; this page only hints and requires clinical review.
map.本页按 Ccr 分段：≥80 正常范围、50–79 轻度下降、25–49 中度下: This page uses Ccr strata: ≥80 normal range, 50–79 mildly reduced, 25–49 moderately reduced, 10–24 severely reduced, <10 very severely reduced. These are functional descriptions of Ccr, not KDIGO 2012 CKD stages G1–G5 (eGFR-based). "End-stage kidney disease" is a clinical diagnosis and is not concluded here.
map.提示：收集24h尿液前3天需低蛋白饮食（<40g/d），禁食肉食，避免剧烈运动，: Note: for 3 days before 24h urine collection, follow a low-protein diet (<40 g/d), avoid meat, and avoid strenuous exercise to keep creatinine excretion stable. Ccr reflects glomerular filtration, but tubules also secrete creatinine, so Ccr slightly exceeds true GFR. Ccr strata do not replace eGFR/CKD staging; this tool is for learning and requires clinical review.
